title: QSOT-Harness v2.1.0 — Bounded, Epistemically-Labeled Verification Harness (Honest Reconstruction)
primary_purpose: Document, as a reproducible and auditable record, how each defect diagnosed in the 0057 slop artifact was remediated and evolved into a bounded, epistemically-labeled honest harness -- i.e. the verifiable slop-to-honest delta, defect by defect with evidence, not merely a clean re-run. See slop_remediation_map in analysis_result.json.
working_hypothesis: QSOT-Harness v2.1.0 is the honest reconstruction of the v1.2.3 slop artifact (toe-test-0057): a bounded, epistemically-labeled verification harness whose every output declares its evidence class and whose claim boundary is machine-readable. It is verified for model-output consistency only, not external physical validity.
validation_stack: 8-phase pipeline / 50 checks (temporal-state axioms, flat/curved baselines, relativistic boosts, flat-relative Kirkwood-Dirac, TTM non-Markovianity, Rust turbovec sidecar, scientific audit)
Claim-integrity governance gate (CI: workspace-leak + overclaim scan over code, docs, and manuscript)
LaTeX manuscript with SHA-256-anchored frozen evidence (paper/evidence/)

External experimental validation of the model

api_summary.title: QSOT-Harness — bounded epistemically-labeled verification harness
api_summary.brief: Documents how the 0057 slop artifact was diagnosed and remediated, defect by defect, into a bounded honest harness; published and Zenodo-archived. Model-consistency only.
api_summary.summary: The honest reconstruction of QSOT (Quantum State Over Time). Runs an 8-phase, 50-check pipeline over six spacetime backgrounds and emits a machine-readable result with a fixed claim boundary, a 7-class evidence taxonomy, environment-dependent backend surfacing, a calibration manifest, and a strict separation of detector self-tests from model-generated signals. The DEGRADED_PASS verdict is honest: the KD optimizer does not converge within its fixed budget, and the optional governance backend is absent.
findings: 48/50 checks passed, 1 skipped (optional DQE backend absent), 1 degraded (KD optimizer non-convergence) — surfaced, not hidden
Verdict limited to model-output consistency only — no external physical validity claimed
Raw Kirkwood-Dirac negativity is generic (present even in flat baseline); only the flat-relative delta is reported, explicitly not a contextuality proof
Non-Markovianity 'pass' is a synthetic detector self-test; the model trajectory itself is Markovian by construction (nm = 0)
Supersedes 0057: fabricated citation removed and replaced with a real reference; published with Zenodo DOI
